cmd: gh run download 41608166057 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim -n bench-dat-2 -D d7; gh run download 41234932764 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim -n r5val-net -D ft; f=$(find d7 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c | sort | head -2); echo $f; PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/trim.py $f; r=0; for g in 333 342; do python3 tools/botsim/train/train.py --data $f --init ft/net.bnnw --policy-min-sims 1 --window 0 --steps 200 --value-ante 1 --value-weight 1 --value-win 0 --anchor 1 --chosen 1 --gf $g --out $OUT/net$g.bnnw > $OUT/train$g.txt 2>&1 || r=1; grep -E 'cut|widened|^records' $OUT/train$g.txt; tail -1 $OUT/train$g.txt; python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tools/botsim/train'); from bnn.model import Net; m=Net.from_file('$OUT/net$g.bnnw'); print('GF', m.cfg['GF']); assert m.cfg['GF']==$g" || r=1; PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/test/unjudged_mass.py $OUT/net$g.bnnw $f 2>&1 | tail -1; done; timeout 2400 luajit tools/botsim/train/eval.lua weights=$OUT/net333.bnnw who=net sims=32 K=24 fair=1 search_ph=shop,pack,blind_select quick_clear=1 pace=1.25 ro_h=1 ro_mon=0.5 ro_net=9 ro=128 ro_a=32 ro_z=2 curve=1 prefix=BENCH solver=std solver_qc=0 ro_fast=1 solver_h=5 solver_en=32 solver_hb=1 ro_order=1 ro_base=0 solver_tie=1 ro_h2=3,4,5,6,7 ro_c=5 solver_sell=1 ro_jt=1 ro_jth=1 ro_jtab=tools/botsim/ci/stab_w12.txt ro_swap=1 blog=1 ro_a=16 ro_ordro=2 stakes=1 first=62901 seeds=1 decks=b_red max_steps=4000 jsonl=$OUT/g_n333.jsonl > $OUT/g_n333.txt 2>&1 & timeout 2400 luajit tools/botsim/train/eval.lua weights=$OUT/net342.bnnw fe_ext=1 who=net sims=32 K=24 fair=1 search_ph=shop,pack,blind_select quick_clear=1 pace=1.25 ro_h=1 ro_mon=0.5 ro_net=9 ro=128 ro_a=32 ro_z=2 curve=1 prefix=BENCH solver=std solver_qc=0 ro_fast=1 solver_h=5 solver_en=32 solver_hb=1 ro_order=1 ro_base=0 solver_tie=1 ro_h2=3,4,5,6,7 ro_c=5 solver_sell=1 ro_jt=1 ro_jth=1 ro_jtab=tools/botsim/ci/stab_w12.txt ro_swap=1 blog=1 ro_a=16 ro_ordro=2 stakes=1 first=62901 seeds=1 decks=b_red max_steps=4000 jsonl=$OUT/g_n342.jsonl > $OUT/g_n342.txt 2>&1 & timeout 2400 luajit tools/botsim/train/eval.lua weights=ft/net.bnnw who=net sims=32 K=24 fair=1 search_ph=shop,pack,blind_select quick_clear=1 pace=1.25 ro_h=1 ro_mon=0.5 ro_net=9 ro=128 ro_a=32 ro_z=2 curve=1 prefix=BENCH solver=std solver_qc=0 ro_fast=1 solver_h=5 solver_en=32 solver_hb=1 ro_order=1 ro_base=0 solver_tie=1 ro_h2=3,4,5,6,7 ro_c=5 solver_sell=1 ro_jt=1 ro_jth=1 ro_jtab=tools/botsim/ci/stab_w12.txt ro_swap=1 blog=1 ro_a=16 ro_ordro=2 stakes=1 first=62901 seeds=1 decks=b_red max_steps=4000 jsonl=$OUT/g_r5.jsonl > $OUT/g_r5.txt 2>&1 & wait; tail -n 2 $OUT/g_*.txt; for t in n333 n342 r5; do test -s $OUT/g_$t.jsonl || r=1; done; wc -l $OUT/g_*.jsonl; echo gft exit $r; exit $r

label: n13a
cmd: for i in $(seq 1 200); do n=$(gh run view 42207582470 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim --json jobs -q '[.jobs[]|select(.status=="completed" and (.name|startswith("dat-")))]|length'); [ "$n" -ge 20 ] 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 60; done; [ "$n" -ge 20 ] || exit 1; echo data jobs done $n; gh run download 42207582470 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim -p 'bench-dat-*' -D gen13; gh run download 41234932764 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim -n r5val-net -D ft; PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/trim.py $(find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr'); PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/relabel.py gen13; ls gen13 | head -3; find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c | wc -l; python3 tools/botsim/train/train.py --data $(find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c) --init ft/net.bnnw --policy-min-sims 1 --window 0 --steps 20000 --value-ante 1 --value-weight 1 --value-win 0 --anchor 1 --gf 333 --out $OUT/net.bnnw > $OUT/train.txt 2>&1; tail -3 $OUT/train.txt; PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/test/unjudged_mass.py $OUT/net.bnnw $(find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c | sort | head -6) >> $OUT/mass.txt 2>&1; tail -1 $OUT/mass.txt; test -s $OUT/net.bnnw
